text:
emma: Opening PR to tidy the Quickstart onboarding page. Goals: add C# minimal example, tighten .env instructions (use .env.local note), and remove the old `redwood-cli deploy` step that confused new users. PR: http://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pull/4301

docs-bot: PR #4301 created by emma  lint checks queued.

rafael: Thanks! Can we also add a tiny troubleshooting note about 401s when REDWOOD_API_KEY present but wrong scope? One sentence under troubleshooting should do.

ophelia: I'll take the C# snippet. Proposal: show HttpClient minimal POST and then a link to the NuGet package `Redwood.Inference` for production. Keep it one short method.

emma: Sounds good. Also swapping examples to use REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_ENDPOINT placeholders consistently. Removing the "publish to docs" step which is outdated.

ci-bot: markdown-lint: flagged inconsistent code fence languages in quickstart/hello.md.

emma: Fixed fences and pushed. Added .env.local suggestion: "For local dev, create a .env.local file and add REDWOOD_API_KEY=...; avoid committing .env.local."

ophelia: Pushed C# snippet:```csharp
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text;
var client = new HttpClient();
client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Add("Authorization", $"Bearer {Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_API_KEY")}");
var resp = await client.PostAsync(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_ENDPOINT") + "/v1/generate", new StringContent("{\"input\":\"hi\"}", Encoding.UTF8, "application/json"));
var body = await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
Console.WriteLine(body);
```

pr-bot: Note: starter-repo Dockerfile issue mentioned in PR comments; link starter PR #91 for pinning node.

rafael: Left a tiny nit about the troubleshooting wording; otherwise LGTM.

emma: Pushed wording tweak and added a single-line note: "If you run into 401s, ensure your token has the right scopes and is not expired; 403 indicates permissions/organization mismatch."

docs-bot: CI passed  link-check OK.

emma: Merging after CI green. Will open follow-up to add a C# production sample using the SDK once packaging lands.

docs-bot: PR #4301 merged by emma (:rocket:).

ophelia: Nice! I'll follow up with a small PR for the NuGet/SDK example.

emma: Thanks all :sparkles:
